title: Correlative insights into luteolin regulating the macrophage-p53-CCNB1/CDK1 axis associated with cell-cycle control in hepatocellular carcinoma.
snippet: The polarization of macrophages and the deactivation of oncogenic pathways within the tumor microenvironment are directly linked to the evolution of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), a relatively frequent cancer in the world.
